conclusion: submit() has exactly one active production call site (the writing page) and is the first-draft long-running submission path; changing it to the shared long-running policy affects only the two approved essay-submission modes (first draft and writing-page revision). No unrelated call sites exist.

first_draft_path.mode_notes: The writing page submits BOTH first drafts (task_new_independent; revision_of_submission_id=None) and writing-page revisions (task_revision_within; revision_of_submission_id=<selected>) through the same submit() call; the incident essay 27 was a first draft.
first_draft_path.pending_state: none - only loading_box('student_writing_submitting') while the run is blocked; no session-state guard; a second click after the timeout error issues a second POST
first_draft_path.retry_policy: no automatic retry (retry only ever applies to GET)
first_draft_path.success_handling: stores submission_result and reruns to the saved state
first_draft_path.timeout_exception_handling: ApiClientError REQUEST_TIMEOUT -> render_api_error -> error_request_timeout ('The request took too long and was stopped. Please try again.') + error_operation_suffix '(while submit)' + Retry button (retryable)

linked_revision_path.mode_notes: v0.9.6-A verified behavior; must be preserved.
linked_revision_path.pending_state: session-state guard (revision_submit_pending / revision_submit_outcome); queued clicks consumed without a second POST; release after success/outcome consumption/ordinary error
linked_revision_path.success_handling: stores submission_result and reruns to the saved state
linked_revision_path.timeout_exception_handling: REQUEST_TIMEOUT -> bounded read-only reconciliation (server-timestamp baseline + revision candidates + submission bundle) -> CONFIRMED_SUCCESS / STILL_PROCESSING / UNCONFIRMED messages; no Retry button

submit_call_sites.usage: first drafts AND writing-page revisions (same long-running pipeline)
